Detail.ShowOnHomeTooltip: When off, this item never appears in the Home page's rows (Continue watching / Recently added / Highest rated).

Re-fetch this item's title, description, dates, episode count and artwork info from the provider?

Editor.ImagesNote: Images are copied into your data folder when you save.
Editor.NotFound: That media item could not be found.

Tags.Title: Tags
Tags.EmptyMessage: Create tags here, or add them while editing a media item.
Tags.DeleteUsedFormat: Delete the tag "{0}"? It will be removed from {1}.
Tags.CleanupConfirm: Delete every tag that is not attached to any media?

Tags.DragToPagePrevTooltip: Hold a dragged tag here to go to the previous page

Seasons.Title: Seasons
Seasons.Subtitle: Anime by original broadcast year and season — not when you watched it.
Seasons.EmptyMessage: Add anime with a broadcast year and season, and they will show up here.
Seasons.NothingMessage: No anime in your library was broadcast in this season.
Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.DataFolderDesc: Your library database, artwork, logs and backups live here.
Settings.ClearLogsConfirm: Delete the app.log files in the logs folder? AniVault keeps logging afterwards — this just clears the history.
Settings.ClearLogsFailed: Could not clear the log files. See the log for details.
Settings.ChangeDataFolderPick: Choose a new AniVault data folder
Settings.ChangeConfirm:
AniVault will point at the new folder and then close.

Your existing data is NOT moved automatically — copy the contents of the old folder into the new one first if you want to keep it.

Continue?
Settings.ChangeDone: Data folder updated. AniVault will now close; start it again to continue.
Settings.ChangeFailed: Could not update the data folder. See the log for details.
Settings.FolderMissing: That folder does not exist yet.
Settings.BackupDesc: Back up your whole library (database + artwork) to a ZIP you can copy to another drive or computer. On a new machine, install AniVault, then use Restore to load the backup. Everything is offline.
Settings.ExportDesc: Export a Markdown document listing everything you have watched — full details, grouped by type and watch status (completed vs. still watching).
Settings.NetworkDesc: AniVault never accesses the internet on its own. These switches only allow features that still require an explicit action from you (the 'Search online' and 'Refresh metadata' buttons).
Settings.MetadataProviderDesc: Choose which source 'Search online' and 'Refresh metadata' use. Pick whichever is reachable from your network.
Settings.ApiKeySaveFailed: Could not save the API key.
Settings.DatabaseDesc: Schema is kept up to date automatically with Entity Framework Core migrations.
FirstRun.Title: Welcome to AniVault
FirstRun.Intro: Choose a folder where AniVault will keep your library database, artwork and backups. You can pick a folder on any drive — for example D:\AniVaultData. Everything works offline; no internet connection is needed.
FirstRun.BrowseTitle: Choose where AniVault should store your library
FirstRun.FolderNotWritable: That folder is not writable. Please choose another location.
FirstRun.SetupFailed: Setup failed. See the log for details, then try a different folder.

Online.SelectToPreview: Select a result to preview it.
Online.ImportGenres: Add the provider's genres as tags
Online.DownloadPoster: Download the poster into my data folder
Online.PosterDownloadOff: Poster downloading is off — enable it in Settings to turn these on.
Online.MultiSelectHint: Ctrl/Shift-click to select several, then add them all at once.

Online.ProviderNeedsKeyFormat: {0} needs an API key. Add it in Settings → Metadata.

Online.NoDetails: That result has no details available.

Online search looks up a title's description, dates and poster from Bangumi, AniList or TMDB. AniVault stays offline until you turn this on, and it only ever runs when you press a button.

Turn it on now? (You can change this later in Settings → Network.)

Backup.ChooseFolder: Choose a folder for the backup (e.g. a USB drive)
Backup.InvalidFormat: That file is not a valid AniVault backup.

CustomProvider.Title: Custom metadata provider
CustomProvider.Intro: Describe one REST API. AniVault calls the search URL (with {query} replaced), reads the JSON at the paths you give, and turns the results into a provider you can pick like any other. Nothing is contacted until you search.
CustomProvider.Name: Name
CustomProvider.DetailsHint: Used when a Details URL is set; otherwise the search row is reused.
CustomProvider.GenreNameField: Genre name field (blank if the array holds plain strings)
CustomProvider.DeleteConfirm: Remove the custom provider configuration and its saved API key?
CustomProvider.Invalid: Enter at least a name and a search URL that contains {query}.
CustomProvider.SaveFailed: Could not save the custom provider. See the log for details.
Rating.GuideSummary: Score Plot, Production, Characters, Music & sound and Personal immersion 0–10 each (50 total → ÷ 5). Bonus is extra credit and never changes the five facet scores.
Rating.QuestionnaireTooltip: Score each facet by the rubric; AniVault computes the final rating.
Rating.QuestionnaireIntro: Score five facets 0–10. Final = total ÷ 5, plus up to +0.5 of bonuses, capped at 10.0.
CompressArtwork.Title: Compress oversized artwork
CompressArtwork.Description: Downloaded and imported artwork is always kept at its original resolution. Listed below is every stored poster/backdrop wider than the app ever displays — nothing is changed unless you pick items and press Compress.
CompressArtwork.EmptyMessage: Every stored poster/backdrop is already within the app's display size.
CompressArtwork.ScanFailed: Could not scan the library for oversized artwork. See the log for details.
CompressArtwork.CompressFailed: Could not compress the selected artwork. See the log for details.
Crash.Continue:
Something went wrong, but AniVault will keep running.
If this keeps happening, check the log file in your data folder.
Crash.RestartPrompt:
AniVault has hit several errors in a row and may be in a bad state.

Restart it now? Your library is saved and will not be affected.
